title: Budget comparisons and fuel-cost impact
summary: This topic combines disparate budget-related remarks, including a positive contrast about reduced fuel costs and undetermined references to affordability comparisons with other vehicles.

positive.summary: One positive review says reduced fuel costs have a meaningful impact on the owner's budget.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention another model being beyond budget, having budget for a Grandeur, and fuel-cost effects on budget without enough context to infer sentiment toward the G60.

limitations: The sample is very small and most fragments are undetermined, so sentiment conclusions are limited.
This cluster mixes unrelated budget themes, including competitor affordability, budget thresholds, and fuel-cost impact.
The only labeled positive example appears textually inconsistent with its assigned sentiment, so the interpretation should follow the provided label with caution.
